row.evidence: Reflektive's help centre supports SAML 2.0 SSO and loads employees from HRIS feeds (BambooHR, SFTP CSV where "terminated users are omitted from your data sheet"); no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Reflektive is now sold by PeopleFluent with no public pricing (Book a Demo); reflektive.com redirect-loops for every client. No SCIM: employees come from HRIS sync (BambooHR integration, or a full active-employee CSV over SFTP from ADP, Paylocity, Ceridian, UltiPro, etc.), manual admin entry, or the by-request REST API (add, update, terminate, unterminate, anonymise employees). SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta OIN SAML app, Entra gallery SSO tutorial, AD FS, OneLogin) and Google OAuth are supported, without JIT. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).
row.user_api_plan: By request (all customers; token issued by the CSM)

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Reflektive help centre (search: scim returns nothing) or the OpenAPI spec. Employees are loaded by HRIS sync (BambooHR and other integrations, or a full-file CSV over SFTP), the Employees API, or manually. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

capabilities.notes: delete_user = anonymise all PII for an employee. Teams and role assignments are read-only (list teams, list users with roles).

limitations.text: Reflektive does not support or develop against the API beyond its public documentation; API access is by request only.

user_api.notes: API access is by request: the Engagement Manager or CSM issues an API token and company UUID. No public plan table, so api_tax is unknown.

okta.notes: OIN app ticks SAML only (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Microsoft Learn SSO tutorial; no provisioning tutorial found.

google.notes: Google OAuth sign-in, not a SAML catalogue app.

onelogin.notes: Reflektive's login article names OneLogin as a supported SSO provider; no connector page checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS sync: BambooHR integration and a recurring full-file CSV feed over SFTP from ADP, Paylocity, Ceridian, UltiPro and others
fallbacks.notes: jit false: the login article says profiles are not created automatically when users join. The SFTP feed must list all active employees each time; employees missing from the file are terminated.
